final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), s AS (SELECT gender, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g) SELECT gender, cnt AS order_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS above_average FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)
